instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: game demos should come back.

The Metal Gear Solid 2 demo came with Zone of the Enders, and people bought ZOE just for it. Resident Evil Village's free demo sold the game better than any trailer could. Final Fantasy VII Remake had a demo too. A free hour beats a hundred ads. Agree?
